fi-bodianus-rufus.title: Spanish Hogfish
fi-bodianus-rufus.summary: A Caribbean hogfish that will pick parasites off tankmates; best for large fish-only tanks.
rows: About 10 in; wild record 40 cm (15.7 in) TL (FishBase)
No. A reef becomes its buffet; keep it fish-only
Carnivore. Adults eat snails, worms, shrimp, mussels and small fish; feed meaty foods
Western Atlantic: Bermuda, southern Florida (USA) and throughout the Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean Sea to southern Brazil
notes: Needs a large fish-only tank (about 150 gal or more).

fi-bodianus-bimaculatus.title: Two-Spot (Candy) Hogfish
fi-bodianus-bimaculatus.summary: A small hogfish that fits tanks as small as about 30 gal.
rows: About 4 in; wild record 5.9 cm (2.3 in) SL (standard length) (FishBase)
With caution. A grown fish may eat small ornamental shrimp added after it
Carnivore. Enriched brine or mysis shrimp, other meaty foods and marine flake
Indo-Pacific: Madagascar to New Caledonia, Japan to New Zealand

fi-bodianus-mesothorax.title: Coral Hogfish (Split-level Hogfish)
fi-bodianus-mesothorax.summary: A boldly marked western Pacific hogfish (dark purple with yellow spots as a juvenile). Hardy and active, it hunts invertebrates and needs a big tank.
rows: Can be very aggressive toward other fish
With caution: safe with most corals, but hunts shrimp, crabs, urchins and worms
Meaty foods: shrimp, krill, mysis and other invertebrate-based foods
Western Pacific (Japan to Australia, New Caledonia and Fiji) and the eastern Indian Ocean
notes: Secure the rockwork: it rearranges rocks and sand.
Needs lots of swimming space and hiding places.

fi-bodianus-diana.title: Diana's Hogfish
fi-bodianus-diana.summary: A red-brown hogfish with white and dark spots from the Indian Ocean. Hardy and active, it hunts small invertebrates and is best in fish-only tanks.
rows: About 6.7 in (17 cm) in the wild; listed up to 10 in
No: may harm vulnerable invertebrates and small, docile fish
Carnivore: shrimp, krill, mysis and other meaty foods
Indian Ocean: African coast to the Nicobar and Cocos-Keeling Islands
notes: Keep only one Diana's hogfish per tank, with plenty of live rock.
